items.title: 12.10 Dikhne wali kaainat ka zyada tar maadda plasma hai (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.10 (PDF 274-275) in the book's order, with the correction, a table and a self-check.

blocks.text: Hamari kaainat hamari soch se kahin bari hai: hum is ke sirf 5% hisse ke bare mein jante hain aur baqi 95% ke bare mein nahi jante. Maslan kaainat ka taqreeban 27% na-maloom maadda hai jise dark matter kehte hain, aur taqreeban 68% ek pur-asrar 'antigravity' cheez hai jise dark energy kehte hain. 27% + 68% = 95%. Yani kaainat ke 95% ke bare mein hum kuch nahi jante.

Doosri taraf, jo 5% hum jante hain (aam maadda), us ka zyada tar hissa hydrogen aur helium hai, aur yeh dono taqreeban plasma halat mein hain (itne garam ke atoms se electrons alag ho jate hain). Kitab ke hisaab se is 5% ka 95% plasma halat mein hai aur baqi 5% doosri shakal mein. Is liye nateeja yeh hai ke dikhne wali kaainat ka zyada tar maadda plasma hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan likhti hai ke maloom 5% mein 68% hydrogen, 27% helium aur 5% aam maadda hai. Yeh 68%, 27% aur 5% to poori kaainat mein dark energy, dark matter aur aam maadde ke hisse hain jo ghalti se dobara likh diye gaye; aam maadda khud apna hissa nahi ho sakta. Sahi: aam maadda taqreeban 74-75% hydrogen, 24% helium aur 1-2% bhaari elements hai (kitab ka apna topic 12.9 72% hydrogen aur 24% helium deta hai).

blocks.caption: Kitab ki kaainat ki tasveer
rows: taqreeban 5%; zyada tar plasma halat mein hydrogen aur helium

blocks.prompt: Dikhne wali kaainat ke zyada tar maadde ko plasma kyun kaha ja sakta hai?
blocks.explanation: Zyada tar dikhne wala maadda sitaron aur sitaron aur galaxies ke darmiyan garam gas mein hai. Un ki hydrogen aur helium itni garam hai ke un ke atoms azaad electrons aur nuclei mein ionize ho jate hain, jo plasma halat hai; Zameen jaise aam solids, liquids aur neutral gases bohat chhota hissa hain.

items: Kaainat ka taqreeban 95% na-maloom hai: dark matter (taqreeban 27%) aur dark energy (taqreeban 68%). Maloom 5% mein hydrogen aur helium taqreeban sab plasma halat mein hain, is liye dikhne wala zyada tar maadda plasma hai.
